summary: Learn IWA water balance, DMA monitoring, pressure management, and NRW prioritization. Build a practical utility action plan. Explore the course.
lede: Non-revenue water reduction training helps water distribution professionals measure system losses and prioritize network interventions. Designed for utility engineers, operations managers, DMA technicians and technical advisers, it covers water-balance calculations and flow analysis, pressure management and leak investigation, and comparing interventions by cost and performance. Exercises use digital meter data and GIS workflows to produce a loss-reduction action plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for water distribution losses, utility performance, and the operational or financial decisions that shape NRW interventions.
modules: NRW Fundamentals and IWA Water Balance
District Metered Areas and Flow Analysis
NRW Reporting and Utility Action Planning
prerequisites: Working knowledge of water distribution operations, utility records, or network maintenance is recommended. Basic familiarity with flow, pressure, and customer metering will help you apply the exercises. Coding is not required; exercises use calculations, structured worksheets, and GIS examples.
